prompt:
IMAGE TO VIDEO REQUEST: ONE SHORT ANIMATION CLIP.

WHAT THIS IS
A 2D sprite animation of the exact character in the attached first-frame image, preserving her exact face, proportions, hair, outfit, accessories, and hand-drawn colored pencil and ink caricature style throughout every frame.

CAMERA AND BACKGROUND
Locked static camera with zero movement. The character stays facing left on the exact same spot on a flat, solid pure magenta background with no shadows, lighting changes, or visual effects. Silent clip.

MOTION: HOT FLOOR HOPS
From her starting relaxed stance, she gasps and shifts her weight quickly from one foot to the other three times with her arms flapping, as if the floor is too hot to touch, staying on the exact same spot. Without hopping again, she settles into her starting relaxed stance and remains completely still in that pose for the rest of the clip.
